versions.changelog:
No significant code changes detected. Minor update to the skill description for clarity:

- Expanded the skill description trigger phrase list to include both Chinese and English trigger terms within one sentence.
- No changes to functionality or underlying logic.

Initial release of 1688 (Alibaba China) product search and analysis skill:

- Enables Chinese keyword-based product searches on the 1688 wholesale platform.
- Lets users filter by price, sales, supplier type (factory/store), service options, and fulfillment features.
- Returns structured product tables with sales metrics, pricing tiers, supplier/trust data, and direct links.
- Supports English-to-Chinese keyword translation and showcases recent hot-selling or new products.
- Handles searches by product ID, URL, and supports custom result pagination.
